lesson: DD 7/22 overlay on IndMom+QualityGate(Q07 top 80%) fails to improve risk-adjusted returns. Base signal already weak (pure SR ~0.427→0.325 post-DD). DD_START=7%, DD_FULL=22%, DD_MIN_EXP=30% is too aggressive for a strategy with MDD ~45%: the brake engages frequently, cutting exposure in prolonged drawdowns and destroying compounding (CAGR 4.57% vs BM 9.03%). OOS retention collapses to 0.337. FF5 alpha is -5.25% (t=-0.91). Lesson: DD overlay cannot rescue a weak base signal — it only compresses returns while MDD remains high (37.35%). For IndMom specifically, the high inherent MDD means DD parameters must be calibrated wider (e.g., DD_START=15%, DD_FULL=35%) or the base signal must first demonstrate positive alpha before overlay. Ref: Moskowitz & Grinblatt 1999 industry momentum, Novy-Marx 2013 quality-momentum interaction.
